questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:

FUTILITARIAN
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Hopeless)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Futilitarian"** refers to someone who believes that human striving is futile and meaningless. It conveys a sense of hopelessness and the idea that efforts or actions are pointless. (निराशावादी और व्यर्थ मानने वाला व्यक्ति)

 
 
• **Example:** John’s futilitarian outlook made him believe that his efforts to improve the world would never amount to anything.
 
 
 
• **"Hopeless"** means having no hope; feeling despair or having no chance of success. (निराशाजनक)
 
 
• **Example:** She felt hopeless after failing the test despite her hard work.
 
 
 
• Thus, the synonym of **Futilitarian** is **Hopeless**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Hopeless)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pragmatic** (व्यावहारिक): Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical considerations rather than theoretical ideas.

 
 
• **Example:** She took a pragmatic approach to solving the issue, focusing on what could be achieved immediately.
 
 
 
• **Useful** (उपयोगी): Able to be used for a practical purpose or in several ways.
 
 
• **Example:** This tool is very useful for fixing small household items.
 
 
 
• **Cynical** (निंदक): Believing that people are motivated purely by self-interest; distrustful of human sincerity or integrity.
 
 
• **Example:** His cynical attitude made it hard for him to trust anyone’s intentions.
